title: Code and data for: What paired variant assays can and cannot identify about molecular dominance
description: Analysis code, redistributable inputs, derived outputs, figures, regression tests and Lean 4 proofs for the paper What paired variant assays can and cannot identify about molecular dominance. The code is under the MIT licence; data files keep the licences of their sources, listed file by file in analysis/INPUT_RIGHTS.json. Inputs that may not be redistributed are restored by analysis/restore_external_inputs.py from their original sources, checked against recorded SHA-256 checksums.
